name: Patron's Body
description: The wealthy patron lies beside the base of the astronomical clock, his evening coat dusted with brass filings.
inspectText: There are no signs of a struggle across the room. A small crescent bruise near the temple matches the curve of a clock weight rather than a hand weapon.

name: Stopped Astronomical Clock
description: Pendlewick's grand clock shows moons, planets, and an alarm dial frozen beneath a dusty glass face.
inspectText: The clock stopped at 8:47, exactly where the alarm pin is set. One brass socket in the calendar train is empty, and the alarm hammer is half-released.

name: Front Door Latch
description: A brass latch on the main workshop door, polished at the handle and scratched near the catch.
inspectText: A thin waxy residue clings to the latch notch. Fine parallel scratches suggest a thread was pulled through the gap after the door was shut.

name: Appointment Ledger
description: A neat ledger of private appointments, invoices, and notes for wealthy clients.
inspectText: Tonight's entry names the patron and mentions a private review of 'Hale's accounts before the new trust is signed.' The next line is underlined twice.

name: Old Mechanism Blueprint
description: A folded apprentice drawing of Pendlewick's astronomical clock, annotated in small, careful handwriting.
inspectText: The drawing marks the calendar gear as removable during service. A note says removing it stalls the visible dial without breaking the alarm weight release.

name: Narrow Repair Ladder
description: A small ladder used to reach the clock's upper panels and the high workshop windows.
inspectText: Fresh amber clock oil shines on the third rung. The smear is too high for ordinary floor sweeping and too fresh to be old workshop grime.

name: Numbered Parts Tray
description: A shallow tray with labeled slots for tiny brass wheels, screws, pins, and gear blanks.
inspectText: Slot nineteen is empty and ringed with the same bright oil as the astronomical clock. Its label matches the size stamped on the missing calendar gear socket.

name: Broken Window
description: A small high window is cracked open above a narrow alley, with glass scattered below the sill.
inspectText: One clean footprint in alley dust points away from the workshop. But most of the broken glass lies inside, and the sill dust is barely disturbed.

name: Curtain Cord
description: A tasseled cord hangs beside the broken window's heavy curtain.
inspectText: Tiny glass slivers are caught in the inner fold of the drawn curtain. The pane was broken while the curtain was already closed, from inside the room.

name: Secretary's Leather Folio
description: A slim leather folio Crispin Hale keeps under one arm, stuffed with patron papers and tied with a ribbon.
inspectText: Behind the account papers is a wrapped brass gear stamped with the number nineteen. Its teeth are oily and match the empty socket in Pendlewick's clock.
